name: Tarroja de Segarra (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with a red tower between two red thistles of three flowers.
history: The official flag of Tarroja de Segarra is of proportions 2:3, yellow, with the red tower with yellow door and windows of the arms, 11/16 of the height and 1/4 of the length of the cloth, at the centre, and the two red three-flowered thistles; the municipal council gave initial approval on 4 June 2010, and the flag was definitively approved on 23 December 2010 and published in the DOGC on 17 January 2011.

features.role: tower with yellow door and windows
two thistles of three flowers flanking the tower
